text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I saw Hokko Tarumae arriving at school carrying a large wooden box.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Phew... This? It's a generator! A new product from a local generator shop!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In the darkness with few streetlights...
Whether during festivals or camping...
The generator was always right by our side.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The beacon of hope for my hometown—that is this generator!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to carry the merchandise around
to promote it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, my outfit's felt a bit tight lately...
I figured this would kill two birds with one stone by helping me diet."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring them along to practice and mini-lives too,
so please count on me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, thanks to working so hard promoting her hometown, Hokko Tarumae successfully shed the extra weight!
